#ETH   Why are you always getting caught? If you do these actions well, your account can truly grow!

Brothers, those who can survive in the contract market are never the ones who gamble the hardest, but the ones who execute the most steadily.

I only focus on six words: light position, control losses, follow the trend, average down, exit, compound interest.

Simple, but it can save your life.

1. Light position - first, ensure you don’t get wiped out

When following my trades, the initial position is always ≤10%.

It's not about being conservative; it's about leaving bullets. A light position gives you another chance to be wrong and is the fundamental premise for continuously eating profits.

2. Control losses - cut immediately at a 3% loss

Before opening a position, I set the stop-loss price; I don’t wait until I feel it.

When losing 3%, cut it. This is not up for discussion; it’s a rule.

You will find that accounts that can stop losses are the ones qualified to make money.

3. Follow the trend - don’t go against it or guess tops and bottoms

In a strong market, I only go long; in a downward trend, I only go short.

There are only two confirmation signals: the direction of moving averages + increasing volume.

If you follow along, you will only catch the tailwind and won't get swept away by pullbacks.

4. Average down - only add to profitable trades

When in profit by 1R, I will remind you to add another position, at most increasing the position by 50%.

If there’s a floating loss? Not adding a penny.

With me, you will learn that averaging down is a reward for profit, not a rescue for mistakes.

5. Exit - taking profits out counts as a real win

Every week, I remind the team to regularly withdraw 20%~30% of the profits.

A real account is what counts as making money; the numbers in the app are just illusions.

By following my trades, you will develop the hardest habit: turning “market” into “savings.”

6. Compound interest - roll half of the profits back in

Withdraw half, leave half to continue to chase the next wave.

You will find that it’s not about getting rich from one trade, but about constantly minimizing losses and maximizing wins, allowing the account to naturally grow over time.

I execute these rules every day and lead my fans to do the same.

If you also want to join our rhythm, trade steadily, and earn consistently, then follow Ice Brother, I’m always here!!!

· On November 4th, opened a 25x leveraged long position with only 16,700 dollars left

Market drop → Holding on to position → Further drop → Repeated liquidation
He built a castle in the air with high leverage, only to have it collapse in the storm of the market.

· On September 18th, he had an unrealized profit of 44.84 million dollars, a giant whale shining across the chain
· On October 11th, the market plummeted, he chose to hold on, and ultimately lost 15 million dollars in principal in the liquidation storm

📝 In the face of all this, he casually left a line on social media:

"Was fun while it lasted."

💔 This is the crypto world - the same story plays out every day, only the protagonists change one after another. High leverage is both an amplifier and a meat grinder.

In the crypto market, DCA means Dollar-Cost Averaging. In simple words, it’s a strategy where you invest a fixed amount of money regularly—like every week or every month—no matter if the market price is high or low.

By investing small amounts continuously, you avoid putting all your money in at the wrong time, and over the long run it reduces the risk of price fluctuations.

Imagine you want to invest in Bitcoin and you have $1200. You have two options:

1️⃣ Invest all the money at once

If you invest the full $1200 at one time and the price drops afterward, you might face a bigger loss.

2️⃣ DCA

You decide to invest $100 every month.
In 12 months, you will have invested the full $1200, but because the price changes every month, sometimes you buy at a low price and sometimes at a high price.

The result?
The impact of price ups and downs becomes smaller, and your risk is reduced.

In simple terms:
DCA is a method where you invest small amounts regularly instead of putting all your money in at once.

title: Strategy-Wednesday #2 - Liquidity-Weighted Allocation: The Mini Liquidity Pool
subTitle:
tl;dr
My portfolio acts like a small liquidity pool — $BTC , $ETH , and $USDC  are the base; everything else orbits around them.I hold a small stack of altcoins not as long-term bets, but as a buffer I can sell high and rebuy lower — a “spot short” position that benefits from their long-term decline against Bitcoin.I only move into USD when BTC is deeply oversold or euphorically overbought — trading fear and greed, not price.
Introduction: What Strategy-Wednesday Is About
Strategy-Wednesday in crypto-jazz explores the logic behind positioning — not how to chase returns, but how to stay aligned with liquidity itself.
Every market has a structure. In crypto, that structure revolves around liquidity gravity — where capital concentrates, where it disperses, and how it cycles between assets.
The idea of Liquidity-Weighted Allocation is to build a portfolio that mirrors that flow instead of resisting it: a personal mini liquidity pool that breathes with the market rather than fighting it.
1 The Mini Liquidity Pool
At the core of my system are three reference assets:
BTC – the gravitational center of crypto.BTC – the connective tissue, bridging networks and capital.USDC (or other stablecoins) – the outside buffer, used only in extremes.
Everything else — altcoins, smaller projects, newer chains — revolves around this structure. I hold some of them, but not for conviction. I hold them for function.
That’s where spot shorting comes in.
2 What “Spot Shortening” Means
In traditional finance, shorting means borrowing an asset to sell it, hoping to buy it back cheaper later. In crypto, you can achieve a similar effect without leverage, simply by holding a small inventory of altcoins and using it dynamically.
Here’s the idea:
You keep a modest stack of altcoins in your portfolio.When they perform well or hype builds, you sell them against Bitcoin.Later, when their price in BTC terms drops again (as it usually does), you rebuy the same coins at a lower ratio.
Over time, this rotation increases your BTC position — without margin, without borrowing, just by trading cycles of relative strength.
Why does this work? Because most altcoins have built-in inflation through token unlocks and emissions. Their supply grows, while Bitcoin’s does not. That means, statistically, they lose value relative to BTC most of the time.
They only outperform during short euphoric phases, when new demand temporarily exceeds new supply. Those bursts last a few weeks, sometimes a month. After that, capital and attention fade, and their long-term trend resumes — steady decline relative to Bitcoin.
So I don’t hold alts as investments — I hold them as ammunition for relative rotation. The “spot short” isn’t a bet; it’s a breathing mechanism for my pool. If an altcoin rises in USD, it’s usually not because it’s stronger — it’s because the total market cap is expanding. But once that expansion slows, they bleed again. Recognizing this rhythm is half the strategy.
3 Trading USD Only in Extremes
USD is not part of my internal ecosystem — it’s the outer boundary. I move into USD only when the whole system becomes unstable — when BTC is either oversold or overbought.
When Bitcoin is oversold, supply exceeds demand. Order books thin out, and liquidity hides. That’s when I buy — not because I know the bottom, but because it’s structurally better to be on the demand side when others panic.
When Bitcoin is overbought, the opposite happens. Greed peaks, funding turns euphoric, and everyone is chasing entries. That’s when I sell — not out of fear, but because it’s better to be on the supply side when the market is desperate for exposure.
These are not emotional decisions; they’re structural rebalances. USD isn’t part of the daily trade — it’s where I wait when the tide goes too far in one direction.
Inside the system, I stay in motion. Outside it, I stay patient.
Question for You
If you treated your portfolio like a breathing system — expanding in greed, contracting in fear — what would your cycle look like?
Share your reflections below or tag #StrategyWednesday on Binance Square.
Feel free to follow me if you’re here to understand how systems learn — through belief, liquidity, and feedback — not just how prices move.
#StrategyWednesday  #CryptoJazz  #BTC  #ETH  #Liquidity

title: 🤔 КТО «переобувается» на крипторынке сейчас?
subTitle:
1. Bitfarms
Очень крупный майнер биткоина объявил, что сворачивает майнинг к 2026–2027 годам и вместо этого полностью переходит к AI / HPC (высокопроизводительные вычисления). 
Причина — снижение маржинальности майнинга, рост затрат, а также возможность заработать больше на централизованных мощностях для обучения моделей ИИ.Они уже подписали контракт примерно на $128 млн, чтобы переоборудовать один из дата-центров под GPU-сервера Nvidia.

2. SharpLink Gaming (SBET)

 Компания, котирующаяся на Nasdaq, раньше была игровой, но теперь держит в своей казне ETH — около 280 706 ETH, что делает её одним из крупнейших корпоративных держателей эфира. Более того, они активно стейкают этот ETH, что приносит дополнительные доходы. При этом SharpLink выкупает собственные акции (на $15 млн), потому что считает, что они торгуются существенно ниже своей «чистой стоимости активов» (NAV), привязанной к ETH. То есть стратегия — не просто накапливать, а делать ETH «продуктивным» активом (через стейкинг).

3. Компании в стиле «Digital Asset Treasury» (DAT)

Растет число публичных компаний, которые ребрендируются или структурируются под хранение криптовалют на своих балансах (как MicroStrategy раньше). Некоторые из них фокусируются именно на $ETH , другие — на $BTC .

ЗАЧЕМ ОНИ ЭТО ДЕЛАЮТ?

Диверсификация доходов: майнинг всё менее прибыльный, особенно после халвингов, и ИИ-инфраструктура может быть более устойчивым источником дохода.Капитализация на крипто­хайпе: компании с большим криптовалютным балансом (казной) потенциально могут привлекать больше инвесторов, особенно институциональных.Доход от стейкинга: держать ETH — это не просто ставить на рост монеты, а и генерировать доход через стейкинг.Регуляторный эффект: некоторые компании хотят позиционировать себя как легитимные институциональные игроки в крипто-пространстве, а не просто спекулянты.

РИСКИ

Переход от майнинга к ИИ — это большая капиталоемкая трансформация (CAPEX), и не факт, что все мощности будут заполнены клиентами.Уровень долга, операционные расходы могут сильно вырасти.При сильной коррекции криптовалют эти «казначейские» компании могут пострадать — если стоимость BTC или ETH упадет, их активы «на бумаге» уменьшатся сильно.

Что это значит для рынка?

Переход публичных компаний к ETH-казнам (а не только BTC) — новый тренд 2025: ETH можно не только хранить, но и стейкать/генерировать доход, поэтому компании видят в нём «продуктивный резерв».

title: Ethereum Tries to Recover but the Market Keeps It in a Tight Zone
subTitle:
Ethereum is moving in a slow and careful way today. The price pushed up after touching 2,950, but it is still struggling with the 3,150 level. Every time ETH gets close to this area, sellers step in and stop the move. The chart shows a clean rejection, and ETH remains below 3,120 and the 100-hour average.
⭐ ETH Tries to Bounce Back
Just like Bitcoin, ETH dropped under 3,200 and moved into a bearish zone. It even slipped under 3,050 and tested the 2,941 low before finding some support. After that, the price slowly climbed above the 50% retracement level of the move from 3,217 → 2,941. This shows buyers are active, but the recovery is still weak.
On the hourly chart, there is a clear negative trend line at 3,150, and this line is holding ETH back. If ETH tries another rebound, this level is the next barrier. If it cannot break this line, the price will stay stuck under resistance.
⭐ What Happens if ETH Breaks Higher
If ETH gets a solid move above 3,150, the next resistance is around 3,220. After that, 3,250 becomes the big obstacle. A clean breakout above that area could open the way toward 3,320, and from there, ETH may try to reach 3,450–3,500 later on. But right now, the chart shows selling pressure at every step.
⭐ What Happens if ETH Falls Again
If ETH cannot break 3,150, the price might drop again. The first support sits near 3,065. Below that, 3,020 becomes very important. A breakdown under 3,020 could pull the price back to 2,950. If this level breaks, the market may test 2,880, and in a deeper move, the next support is 2,750–2,740.
ETH is still in a tight range, trying to recover while the market stays cautious. The candles show slow up-moves and strong pushbacks, which means the trend is not decided yet.
⭐ Market Mood
ETH is trading around 3,029.91 (+0.94%), while BTC is near 90,753.98 (+0.82%). Both coins are steady but not strong. Traders are watching the same levels again and again as ETH moves between support and resistance.

#ETH    In three months, turning 500U into 10,000U: A fool's method that's even tougher than being smart.

I'm not joking; when my brother first entered the circle, he didn't even know what a candlestick chart was. He stared blankly at the trading interface and couldn't find stop-loss or take-profit options.

But three months later, he managed to turn 500U into 10,000U.

It's not about talent, insider information, or top-tier indicators.

What he relied on was a set of "ridiculously foolish yet terrifyingly powerful" methods for turning things around.

I later named it the - Fool's Turnaround Method.

1. Small Position Segmentation: It looks cowardly, but it's actually the first step for experts.

Split 500U into 5 parts, moving only 100U each time.

Others laughed at him, thinking he was joking, but he just said, "Surviving is the only qualification to win."

Every time he made a profit, he followed a formula to increase his position, never relying on gut feelings.

Not making much? But it's stable to a fault.

2. Only Recognize Two Signals: The more chaotic the market, the simpler one must be.

He only focused on two visuals: the 1-hour moving average crossover and the 4-hour MACD zero-axis confirmation.

When both signals appeared simultaneously, he would enter.

The win rate is absurdly high. You say it's simple? But most people can't even stick to simplicity.

3. Discipline So Strict It’s Scary

Set stop-loss and take-profit orders at the moment of opening a position; must cut losses at 1% and take profits at 3%.

No shaking hands, no wandering thoughts, like a machine, but this is the only way retail traders can break through.

4. Compound Interest Snowball: Stability is scarier than aggression.

For every winning trade, he adds half of the profit plus the principal into the next trade.

Continuously profitable, only moving 2% of total funds.

It looks Zen, but in reality, it’s about stacking probabilities like crazy. Others rely on gambling; he relies on a system.

5. Only Trade During Clean Time

No touching non-farm payrolls, no big news. No trading on Fridays.

He loves trading between 1-3 AM, where the volatility is clean and fewer traps.

Do you think trading is about IQ? It’s actually about patience.

In the crypto world, those who lose are never the ones with poor skills; it’s that too many people are restless and impatient, sending themselves into losses.

He can turn things around, not because he’s smart, but because he’s “foolish” enough, stable enough, and tough enough.

连续盈利，只动总资金 2%。

币圈里输的，永远不是技术差的人：是太多人成天心浮气躁，把自己送进去。

title: Ethereum Nears Key Support Level at $3,000—Will This Spark the Next Bull Run?
subTitle:
Ethereum recently hit the $3,000 level, marking a pivotal point for traders and investors alike.
This significant milestone, in line with expert forecasts, indicates a robust accumulation zone and potential market bounce.
Despite short-term volatility, multiple indicators suggest Ethereum is setting the stage for long-term growth as institutional interest continues to boost confidence.
The current levels are viewed by many analysts as an exceptional entry point for strategic, long-term accumulation.
The Significance of the $3,000 Support Zone
Ethereum’s current price around $3,000 is more than just a psychological threshold. It acts as a critical support zone and an indicator of market resilience.
According to CryptoPatel, this price level is considered a bullish order block—implying it’s a zone where significant buy orders are clustered.
If Ethereum maintains this support, it could propel a rally to higher resistance levels.
Conversely, breaking below this support could lead to declines towards $2,400, where buying interest may re-emerge.​
On-chain data further reinforces the importance of this zone. CryptoQuant analysts report Ethereum is close to an accumulation level that has historically signaled market bottoms.
Nearly 17 million $ETH  have flowed into accumulation addresses in 2025, elevating total holdings to over 27 million ETH—highlighting strong conviction among long-term investors.​
Institutional Moves and Market Sentiment
Despite recent fluctuations, institutional activity remains a crucial factor. Last week, Ethereum experienced significant ETF outflows totaling approximately $728.3 million, with BlackRock alone offloading over $421 million worth of $ETH .
This profit-taking signals a shift in short-term sentiment but could stabilize the market by reducing overleveraged speculation.​
Such movements imply a reset in open interest levels, with Ethereum’s open interest now aligning with a $2,200 market price, indicating that overleveraged traders are out of the market.
This reset could fuel a more sustainable long-term rally, especially if Ethereum can establish a new support base at or above current levels.​

Eyes on the Future: Ethereum’s Long-Term Upside
Market projections remain optimistic. Technical analysis points toward Ethereum’s potential to reach between $10,000 and $15,000 within the next few years.
The ongoing development in blockchain infrastructure, ecosystem expansions, and rising institutional involvement underpin these bullish targets.
Crypto analysts emphasize patience and strategic accumulation. As CryptoPatel advises, “Stick to the structure, accumulate smartly, and avoid emotional trading.”
Such an approach could see investors benefit from Ethereum’s upcoming cycles of growth, especially if it maintains support zones and exceeds resistance levels.

Essential Guide for Beginners  🚀

Now that your account is secure 🔐 and you understand the risk of Hype 🔥, let's talk about the buying technique: "The DCA".

The #1 mistake of the novice is: Putting all the money (e.g., $1000) at once. 📉 If the price drops, you end up with total loss!

The Safest Strategy is DCA (Dollar-Cost Averaging) - Average Cost in Dollars:

1. ⏱️ Consistency: Instead of buying $1000 of $BTC  today, you divide the purchase into smaller installments (e.g., $250).
2. 📆 Frequency: You buy $250 every week for four weeks, no matter if the $ETH  is rising or falling.

✅ Advantage of DCA (and Why to Use It):
DCA dilutes your risk over time. You buy at various prices (high, low, and medium), ensuring that your average purchase price is much safer. It's the ideal strategy for those who buy long-term and want to sleep peacefully!

content:
Guia Essencial para Iniciantes  🚀

Já que sua conta está segura 🔐 e você entende o risco do Hype 🔥, vamos à técnica de compra: "O DCA".

O erro #1 do novato é: Colocar todo o dinheiro (ex: R$1000) de uma só vez. 📉 Se o preço cair, você fica no prejuízo total!

A Estratégia Mais Segura é o DCA (Dollar-Cost Averaging) - Custo Médio em Dólar:

1. ⏱️ Consistência:  Em vez de comprar R$1000 de $BTC  hoje, você divide a compra em parcelas menores (ex: R$250).
2. 📆 Periodicidade: Você compra R$250 toda semana, por quatro semanas, não importa se o $ETH  está subindo ou caindo.

The first rule: refuse to gamble with a full position and control risk with your position size.

When the market conditions are still unclear, you must not rashly place heavy bets—start with 10-20% of your position to test the market.

Wait until the trend is fully clear before gradually increasing your position. Many people face liquidation because they are too 'impatient,' jumping in with a full position before clear signals appear. Once the market reverses, they can get stuck deeply.

The second rule: do not add to losing positions, but dare to add to winning ones.

Initially, my friend didn't understand this and thought, 'If it drops, just add a bit to average down; it’s more cost-effective.' But I told him that adding to losing positions only deepens the hole; it’s like doubling down on a poor decision. Instead, let the winning positions continue to profit, with the principal remaining stable, allowing the account balance to grow like a snowball.

The third rule: always go with the trend, do not fight against it.

Follow the direction the market moves in, and never bet on a market reversal. Many people complain that the market is hard to operate in; the difficulty lies not in the market's major fluctuations but in the inability to restrain their own greed for 'bottom-fishing' or 'topping out.'

My friend's success is fundamentally based on strict adherence to discipline. When others chase prices and act impulsively, he restrained his impulses; when others hurried to enter the market and blindly followed trends, he patiently waited for clear signals.

Making money has never relied on esoteric techniques but rather on effectively managing the weaknesses of human nature. Most people fall into a vicious cycle, not due to lack of effort, but due to the absence of proper guidance. The market is often there, but opportunities are fleeting; only by following the right direction can one escape difficulties.

在行情尚未明朗时，绝不能贸然下重注，先以1 - 2成仓位试探市场。

等趋势完全明朗，再分批逐步加仓。很多人爆仓，就是因为太“急”，没等出现明确信号就满仓冲进去，一旦行情反转，就会被深度套牢。

第二条，亏单不补仓，赚单敢加仓。

朋友起初很不理解，觉得“跌了就补点，摊薄成本多划算”。但我告诉他，亏损单补仓只会让自己越陷越深，这是在给错误决策不断加码；而让盈利的单子继续盈利，本金稳如泰山，账户资金才能像滚雪球一样越滚越大。

第三条，永远顺势而为，不与趋势对抗。

行情往哪个方向走，就跟着哪个方向走，绝不去赌行情反转。很多人抱怨市场难做，其实难的并非行情本身的大幅波动，而是难以克制自己“抄底”“摸顶”的贪婪之心。

朋友能成功翻身，核心就在于严格遵守纪律。当别人追涨杀跌、冲动行事时，他克制住了自己的冲动；当别人急于入场、盲目跟风时，他耐心等待明确信号。

还有件事得提一下——大饼最近头上悬着一个“巨量抛压”的定时炸弹。英国政府前阵子缴获了一批特别大的比特币，之前德国政府卖币时不是让市场短线跳水过吗？要是英国这批也往市场砸，考虑到现在流动性很差，杀伤力可能更大。据媒体说，这批有 6.1 万枚 BTC，价值超过 50 亿美金。虽然官方还没公布要卖，但坊间已经在传寻找买家了。


不管怎么说，现在的价格和前几个月比，确实更有吸引力。BTC 已经回调 30% 左右，以太坊再跌几百美金就要离高点腰斩了，山寨更不用说，很多都已经被按在地上摩擦了。光看跌幅，现在肯定算不上牛市了，甚至都半只脚踏进熊市门槛了。从趋势上看，目前还没有明显止跌盘整的迹象，所以我不建议现在上来就满仓抄底。不过从跌幅力度来说，适当捡一点是可以的。我自己是继续用网格慢慢接，再跌一轮我预计总仓位差不多会到 7 成。

title: Виталик Бутерин назвал возможным взлом Ethereum в течение 3 лет. Как быть
subTitle:
Квантовые компьютеры могут взломать $ETH еще до выборов в США 2028 года, поэтому блокчейн должен перейти на квантовоустойчивую криптографию в течение нескольких лет, считает сооснователь Ethereum Виталик Бутерин. Об этом он рассказал на конференции Devconnect в Буэнос-Айресе, передает DL News.
{future}(ETHUSDT)
Бутерин заявил, что криптография на основе эллиптических кривых (Elliptic Curve Cryptography, ECC), лежащая в основе многих криптовалют, включая биткоин и Ethereum, обречена. ECC в криптовалютах используется для генерации ключей и цифровых подписей.
При условии, что развитие квантовых технологий будет идти прежними темпам, у блокчейн-разработчиков есть несколько лет, чтобы создать защиту от квантовой угрозы. И это «потребует координации усилий всей экосистемы», говорит Бутерин.
В связи с растущими рисками основа Ethereum — первый уровень (L1) блокчейна — должен «окостенеть», полагает Бутерин. Инновации должны перейти на второй уровень сети (L2), чтобы предотвратить изменения, которые могут привести к появлению ошибок в системе.
Большая часть транзакций в сети альткоина приходится на L2, где работают приложения, криптокошельки и другие различные пользовательские инструменты. Бутерин заявил, что переключить внимание с L1 на окружающую экосистему полезно, а чем неизменней становится фундамент сети, тем лучше для Ethereum.
Квантовой угрозой взлома криптовалют в сообществе обеспокоены давно, но не все считают ее реальной. Сооснователь Blockstream и один из наиболее известных биткоин-разработчиков Адам Бэк полагает, что появление систем, способных взломать алгоритмы биткоина, маловероятно в перспективе ближайших 20–40 лет.

title: Що говорить де-левереджинг листопада про ринкову структуру Binance.
subTitle:
Між 11-14 листопада Binance обробив щось незвичайне. Обсяг ф'ючерсів BTC знизився на 63% з $11.57B до $4.25B щодня, в той час як обсяг споту зріс на 28% до $3.22B. Ф'ючерси ETH впали на 87% до $1.21B, оскільки спот зріс на 19%. Співвідношення ф'ючерсів до споту перевернулося з 4.70x до 1.01x для BTC і з 5.41x до 0.51x для ETH, що означає, що обсяг споту вперше перевищив ф'ючерси.
Це важливо, тому що це є інверсією Луни або FTX. Під час тих колапсів обсяг споту та ф'ючерсів разом обвалився, оскільки ліквідність зникла. Листопад показав, як ф'ючерси розпадалися, тоді як спот поглинав потік і розширювався. Склад Binance змінився з 82% ф'ючерсів до 63% за чотири дні, ставши 37% спотово-орієнтованим під час пікового де-левереджінгу.
SOL залишався стабільним на рівні 5.92x протягом усього часу, змінившись лише на 0.02%, тоді як співвідношення BTC і ETH інвертувалися. XRP знизився на 12.6%, а BNB залишився незмінним на рівні 2.51x. Якби це була системна криза, кожен актив був би зруйнований однорідно. Натомість альткоїни зберігали свої профілі, вказуючи на ізольоване зниження важелів у похідних BTC і ETH, а не на паніку платформи.
Протягом 72 годин ф'ючерси BTC повернулися до $12.74B, перевищивши базовий рівень на 10%. Співвідношення нормалізувалися до 5.29x. ETH відновився до 4.41x, хоча ф'ючерси залишалися на 19% нижче базового рівня. Luna потребувала місяців і ніколи не відновилася. FTX остаточно зруйнувався. Листопад вирішився за три дні без втручання.
Зростання спотових цін вказує на ротацію позицій, а не на панічний вихід. Трейдери закривали важелі довгих позицій і відновлювалися через незабезпечений спот. Під час Luna та FTX спот зруйнувався, оскільки учасники віддавали перевагу виходу. Листопад показав, що спот діяв як притулок для капіталу, який хотів отримати експозицію без ризику важелів.
Binance обробляв $28B щоденно під час пікового зниження важелів без зупинок торгівлі чи фрагментації ліквідності. Інфраструктура поглинула 63% падіння ф'ючерсів, зберігаючи нормальну роботу.

✅ Educational Content (English)

Why Beginners Lose Money in Crypto – And How You Can Avoid It

Most new traders lose money not because the market is bad, but because they don’t understand how the market actually works.
Here are 5 things every beginner must learn before trading:

1. Price doesn’t move randomly – it follows liquidity

The market rises to grab stop-losses above resistance,
and falls to grab liquidity below support.
If you don’t understand liquidity, you’re trading blind.

2. Never enter a trade without a clear plan

You must know:

Entry

Take profit levels

Stop loss
Not having a plan is the fastest way to lose capital.

3. Trend is your best friend

Trading against the trend is like swimming against the current.
Always check higher-timeframe trend (4H, 1D) before opening any position.

4. Volume tells the truth

If price goes up but volume is low, that move is weak.
If price drops with high volume, sellers are strong.
Learn to read volume – it will save you from traps.

5. Don’t trade with emotions

Fear makes people sell low.
Greed makes people buy high.
Smart traders stay calm and wait for the right setup.

🔍 Final Tip

You don’t need 20 indicators.
You just need:

Trend

Support/Resistance

Liquidity

Volume

If you understand these 4 things,
your trading accuracy will increase automatically.

From 120,000 U to 3,000 U and then to 1,000,000 U: My Journey of Triumph in the Crypto World

In mid-2023, I entered the crypto world with 120,000 U, intending to profit from the momentum, but I encountered a collective correction of altcoins, and my funds shrank to less than 3,000 U.

During that period, I was almost possessed, staring at the market until late at night, always feeling that if I traded a few more times, I could recover my losses.

Contracts exploded again and again, and I couldn't bear to cut my “Faith Coin” even after it dropped by half, watching helplessly as my account balance hit rock bottom, that despair is still etched in my memory.

Just as I was preparing to liquidate my positions, a phrase from a trading community woke me up: “Earn money within your comprehension, don’t be led by emotions.”

I stopped all high-leverage operations and focused on building a trading system. Every night I spent two hours analyzing market sentiment and the K-line structure of coins, only selecting 1 to 2 targets for in-depth research;

I only traded trend positions, entering the market only after confirming key breakout points or retracement resonance points; I would open at most two trades a day, firmly avoiding full positions and trading against the trend, and I would never hesitate once I set my stop-loss and take-profit lines;

Every month I reviewed my win rate and profit-loss ratio, turning the pitfalls I had encountered into the basis for optimizing strategies.

With this system, I steadily progressed, and by April 2024, my account soared from 3,000 U to 1,000,000 U, without ever blowing up my account again.

Now I spend no more than one hour a day on trading, avoiding hot trends and not believing in rumors, relying solely on mature logic and strict rules for stable profits.

The crypto world has never lacked wealth creation myths, nor has it lacked lessons from losses. Those who can truly achieve long-term profits are always those who understand the methods and have self-discipline.

I hope my experience can inspire fellow travelers: let go of luck, build a system, and strictly adhere to discipline to walk steadily and far amidst the fluctuations.

Most people are trapped in a vicious cycle, not due to a lack of effort, but a lack of a guiding light. The market is always present, but opportunities don't wait for anyone—follow the right people @MG566  and you can only step out of the darkness by going to bed early and waking up early. #ETH

💥 Crypto Titans Stabilize  BTC, ETH, XRP Attempt Comeback After Deep Pullback

Bitcoin is about $92,000 on Wednesday after falling below $90,000 this week.

Ethereum's comeback may begin if it holds over $3,017.

After a 6% drop last week, XRP stabilizes around $2.23.

After a severe correction earlier this week, Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Ripple (XRP) recover midweek. After briefly falling below $90,000, BTC is approaching $92,000. ETH and XRP are defending important support levels, predicting a rebound in the coming days.

Bitcoin hits psychological support around $90,000.
Bitcoin fell 2% to $94,253, below the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement mark (drawn from the April 7 low of $74,508 to the October 6 all-time high of $126,299). BTC fell to $89,253 on Tuesday but recovered from the crucial $90,000 threshold to close at $92,960. On Wednesday, BTC was over $92,600.

BTC may rebound to the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement at $94,253 if the psychological level at $90,000 holds.

BTC may continue to decline toward $85,000, the next daily support, if it closes below $90,000.

Ethereum recovers after retesting critical support.
Ethereum dropped roughly 14% last week after hitting the broken trendline around $3,592. At the start of this week, ETH fell to $2,946 on Tuesday before rebounding to $3,017. As of Wednesday, ETH is about $3,118.

Support at $3,017 might help ETH rebound to $3,592, the crucial resistance level.

If ETH closes below $3,017, it might fall below $2,749.

Momentum indicators suggest XRP's bearishness is receding.
Last week, XRP fell roughly 7% when the 50-day EMA rejected it at $2.47. XRP extended its fall on Monday but rebounded somewhat Tuesday. On Wednesday, XRP was approximately $2.21.

XRP may climb to the 50-day EMA at $2.47 if it continues.

XRP might fall to the next daily support around $1.96 if it continues its drop.

Crazy Thursday welcomes "Super Data Tide"! Nvidia + Non-farm payrolls double explosion, but can the crypto winter be reversed?
 
This Thursday will become the "Judgment Day" for the global capital market! Two core events are densely staged: first, the non-farm data along with key employment and wage indicators will make a heavy appearance, directly anchoring the direction of the Federal Reserve's monetary policy; second, the "weather vane of tech stocks" Nvidia's earnings report will headline, which the market sees as a core signal for the turning point of the bull and bear in the capital market, every move affects the global flow of funds.
 
From the time window perspective, if the non-farm data is below expectations (implying easing pressure on interest rates), and Nvidia's earnings report exceeds expectations (confirming the recovery of the tech supply chain), it may inject pulse-like rebound momentum into the risk market in the short term, and BTC may usher in a phase of stabilization. But it must be clear: even if the dual data benefits spur a rebound, it is difficult to change the current trend pattern dominated by bears!
 
Looking back at BTC's performance, after the key point of 1011 saw a crash and rebound, the market showed typical "prolonged decline and bottoming" characteristics - trading volume continues to shrink, the strength of rebounds gradually weakens, coupled with the establishment of the large cycle bull tail pattern in the crypto market, the risk aversion sentiment has entered a white-hot stage. The so-called "rebound expectation" at present is essentially a technical correction within the bearish trend, rather than a signal of trend reversal. This current bearish downward cycle has yet to reach the bottom range, and the winter is far from over!
 
In terms of practical operation, it is recommended to focus on "watch and wait, light positions for trial and error": if the data benefits drive BTC's rebound, light short positions can be set based on short-term resistance levels; if the data disappoints and breaks down directly, it is necessary to resolutely avoid the impulse to bottom fish and patiently wait for clear bottom signals.

疯狂星期四迎"超级数据潮"！英伟达+非农双爆，币圈寒冬却难逆转？
 
本周四将成全球资本市场"审判日"！两大核心事件密集登场：其一，非农数据携就业、薪资关键指标重磅亮相，直接锚定美联储货币政策走向；其二，"科技股晴雨表"英伟达财报压轴登场，市场将其视为资本市场牛熊转折的核心信号，一举一动牵动全球资金流向。
 
从时间窗口看，若非农数据不及预期（暗示加息压力缓解）、英伟达财报超预期（印证科技产业链复苏），短期或为风险市场注入脉冲式反弹动能，BTC或迎来阶段性企稳。但需明确：即便双数据利好催生反弹，也难改当前空头主导的趋势格局！
 
回溯BTC走势，自1011关键点位砸盘反弹后，盘面呈现典型"阴跌磨底"特征——成交量持续萎缩、反弹力度逐步衰减，叠加加密市场大周期牛尾形态确立，资金避险情绪已进入白热化阶段。当前所谓的"反弹预期"，本质是空头趋势中的技术性修正，而非趋势反转信号，这波空头下行周期仍未触及底部区间，寒冬远未结束！
 
对于实操层面，建议以"观望为主、轻仓试错"为核心：若数据利好推动BTC反弹，可依托短期阻力位布局轻仓空单；若数据利空直接破位，需坚决规避抄底冲动，耐心等待底部信号明确。

title: Nhật Bản muốn hạ thuế crypto xuống 20% – tin quy định thay đổi có thể là đòn bẩy lớn
subTitle:
Theo Reuters, Cơ quan Dịch vụ Tài chính Nhật Bản (FSA) đang xem xét quy định mới cho crypto: giảm thuế lợi nhuận từ giao dịch crypto từ mức cao (có nơi lên tới 55%) xuống còn 20%, và định danh crypto như sản phẩm tài chính chịu các quy tắc như giao dịch nội gián.
Nếu quy định này được thông qua, nó sẽ là cú hạ định phí lớn cho nhà đầu tư cá nhân crypto tại Nhật – mở đường cho dòng vốn cá nhân và tổ chức vào thị trường.
Việc crypto được coi là “sản phẩm tài chính” giúp làm minh bạch hoạt động giao dịch, tạo niềm tin hơn cho các nhà đầu tư lớn.
Kinh nghiệm newbie: nếu bạn quan tâm đến các dự án hoạt động tại hoặc có mối liên hệ với Nhật, đây có thể là cơ hội lâu dài; nhưng chưa nên all-in ngay nếu chỉ vì tin này — cần chờ quá trình luật hoá rõ ràng.
Kỹ thuật: dùng tin này như một yếu tố nền tảng để chọn các alt hoặc token sàn Nhật, nhưng vẫn ưu tiên các điểm vào kỹ thuật (breakout, volume, xu hướng).
Quy định tốt + thuế thấp = “cửa” mới cho dòng vốn crypto.
Khi quy định thay đổi tích cực, bạn cần chuẩn bị vốn + chiến lược để tận dụng — không phải chỉ hy vọng.

translatedData.title: Japan wants to reduce crypto tax to 20% – changing regulation news could be a significant leverage
translatedData.subTitle:
According to Reuters, the Financial Services Agency of Japan (FSA) is considering new regulations for crypto: reducing the tax on profits from crypto transactions from a high level (up to 55% in some places) to 20%, and designating crypto as a financial product subject to rules like insider trading.
If this regulation is passed, it will be a significant reduction in fees for individual crypto investors in Japan – opening the door for personal and institutional capital into the market.
